shots.say: Brrr! The snow is so cold. How does a polar bear stay warm?
Look at Poppy! She is not cold at all!
I'm Milo the bluebird. Let's find Poppy's warm secrets!
The Animated Zoo!
Poppy has three warm secrets. Let's find them, one by one!
Warm secret number one! What is under a polar bear's skin?
Is it a layer of fat? Or a layer of ice?
It is fat! Under the skin, a polar bear has a thick layer of fat.
Can you point to the fat? It is the yellow layer, at the bottom!
The fat works like a cozy blanket. It helps keep the bear warm!
How thick is it? Up to four inches! Count with me. One, two, three, four!
Can you show me four fingers? One, two, three, four!
Wow! That is a lot of warm fat!
What does the fat do, when Poppy swims in the icy water?
In the cold water, the fat keeps her warm. And it helps her float!
Can you float like a polar bear? Bob up, and down. Bob, bob!
Say it with me. Thick fat keeps a polar bear warm!
Now wrap your arms around you, like a cozy blanket. So warm!
Quick check! Is a polar bear's fat thin, or thick?
Thick! Thick and warm. Super job!
Warm secret number two! Look at Poppy's fluffy fur. How many layers does it have?
Is it one layer of fur? Or two layers?
Two layers! First, a soft, thick undercoat, close to the skin.
And on top, long guard hairs. They are much longer!
Count the layers with me. One, two!
Pat your arms softly, like a soft, fluffy undercoat. Pat, pat!
The long hairs work like a raincoat. Water rolls right off! Drip, drop!
Put on your raincoat, like a polar bear. Zip it up, all the way!
And look! Fur covers almost all of its body.
Does a polar bear stay warm, even on the very coldest days?
Yes! Fur and fat keep it warm, even on the coldest, snowiest days!
Fluff up your fur, like a fluffy polar bear. Puff!
Say it with me. A polar bear has two layers of fur!
Quick check! What does water do on the long hairs? Roll off, or soak in?
It rolls right off! Great job!
Warm secret number three! The ice is so cold. How does Poppy keep her feet warm?
Is it fur on her feet? Or little socks?
Fur! A polar bear has fur, on the bottoms of its feet.
The fur keeps its feet warm. And it stops it slipping on the ice!
Wiggle your toes, all warm and cozy. Wiggle, wiggle!
Where does a mama polar bear keep her cubs warm?
In a cozy den, in the snow! Inside, it can be much warmer than outside.
The cubs snuggle up to their mama, to stay warm.
Give yourself a cozy snuggle, like a polar bear cub. Snuggle!
Polar bears are so warm, they can even get too hot!
Then they cool off, in the chilly water. Splash!
Can you fan yourself, to cool off? Whoosh, whoosh!
Say it with me. Furry feet keep a polar bear warm!
Quick check! Where do polar bear cubs stay warm? In a den, or in a tree?
In a snow den! You remembered!
Three warm secrets! Now it is quiz time!
What is under a polar bear's skin? A thick layer of fat, or ice?
Thick fat! Like a cozy blanket.
How many layers of fur does a polar bear have? One, or two?
Two layers! Soft fur, and long hairs.
What is on the bottoms of a polar bear's feet? Fur, or feathers?
Fur! Warm, furry feet.
Thick fat, two layers of fur, and furry feet. You found all of Poppy's warm secrets!
Wrap up like a blanket, zip your raincoat, and wiggle your warm toes!
Next time: is a polar bear really white? Bye-bye, friends!
The Animated Zoo!
